title: Remove validated payload passes and replace prepared approval with Analyze and Run
question: Can Chopper remove demonstrably redundant materialization while preserving exact membership, admitted ownership and native/browser publication?
summary: Enabled in this unmerged worktree default build: Analyze returns advisory input statistics, Run is independent, FY-to-Balanced avoids an intermediate Dataset, and a single plain Balanced Run avoids the output snapshot roundtrip. FY cells improve 11–21%; plain Balanced primary small/large cells improve 9.5%/13.9%, with eight-worker large 14.1%; wide plain Balanced is near neutral at 2%.

workloads: Warm WSL2/ext4: 123.60 MiB narrow and 66.96 MiB 33-column inputs, plus 1986.26 MiB under a 256 MiB working budget; exact nondivisible Balanced8, root/retained FY spans, one/automatic/eight workers.

validation.summary: Linux default/all-feature workspace checks, final all-feature Clippy/terminal owner controls, native Windows workspace plus final CLI ownership/interface controls, hosted UI tests, bundled Chromium processing/graph/lifecycle/interruption and WASI resource-contract suites. Final default WASM core and full graph acceptance rerun with identical before/after asset hashes; production artifacts restored.

limitations: Unmerged worktree code, not a release, merge or hosted deployment.
Warm WSL2 performance only; no physical-RAM exhaustion, 40 GiB, cold storage, device bandwidth, Windows/browser throughput or cross-tool reranking claim.
Each cell has 3 pairs except 5 for the small confirmation. Earlier mixed small data remain reported; automatic-worker small ranges overlap. No tail or confidence-interval claim.
Single plain Balanced only; input Dataset remains. Private output may overlap it earlier, so lower total peak filesystem usage and complete RSS caps are not established.
Complete generated evidence navigation remains blocked by invalid duplicate-member historical archive hydration.
exclusions: Warmups, smoke/negative controls, rejected digest-only probe and all failed/interrupted/setup attempts are not complete-Run speed observations.
Initial small screens, mixed three-pair small cohort and unsealed large cohort are retained separately, not pooled with confirmatory cells.
Different row shapes, runtimes and original cross-tool fixtures/percentages are not pooled.
reopen_when: Revisit if matched complete jobs or correctness/admission/publication controls regress. Broader pipelines/codecs and admitted row batching require separate frozen experiments; rejected radix/bucket/copied-parser/adaptive-FY work is not reopened unchanged.
